guide: Open Start and type your business name, your cash floor, the regular owner draw and the share you set aside for income tax (confirm with your adviser).
Keep Profit and Loss, Cash, Tax Set-Aside and Owner Draw up to date each month: the month-end close takes minutes.
Keep Vehicles current: purchase date, price, loan, odometer, status and resale estimate. Age, book value, loan balance and equity fill in.
Add every loan payment to Financing; Loan View shows each financed car with its equity.
Record expenses with a category, vendor and vehicle; Costs by Category adds them up by month.
List the costs you already know for the next 30 days in Known Costs, then open the Owner Draw and Tax Set-Aside tool for the safe draw.
Use the Replace-or-Sell Tool and Best Month to Sell for any vehicle that loses money or is past your replacement age.
Run the Scenario Test after changing the scenario numbers on the Start sheet; read the lowest cash point.
Before you buy, fill Add-a-Vehicle Cases and run the Add-a-Vehicle Business Case; a one-car host also uses the One-Car Host Start-Up Case.
Use the Refinance Check, Early Payoff Test and Sale Proceeds vs Payoff for any loan decision.
At year end run the Year-End Pack Check and send the figures to your accountant.
Use the 18 tools, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Finance Dashboard and the charts every week. Miles are the demo unit, set your own.

listing.title: Car Rental Finance Excel Template: Profit and Loss, Loans, Replace-or-Sell, Owner Draw, Tax Set-Aside, Scenarios
listing.headline: Know your profit, your loans and your safe owner draw
listing.description:
Run the money side of a small car and van rental or a car-sharing host fleet in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-operator, a manager and a part-time bookkeeper who need one clear view of profit, loans, cash and the owner draw. Profit and Loss shows 24 months of revenue and every cost line, with margin, average daily rate (revenue per rented day) and break-even revenue. Profit by Class and Month shows which class earns and which does not. Vehicles keeps price, loan, resale estimate, book value and equity of every car, and Loan View shows each financed car.

Cash, Tax Set-Aside and Owner Draw follow every month, Known Costs lists what you must pay in the next 30 days, and the Draw Plan shows the safe draw for the next 12 months. Replace or Sell Inputs and Keep or Replace give the cost per day of keeping a vehicle against replacing it. Scenarios and Scenario Months test utilisation down, more cars, a higher financing rate, higher marketplace fees and rates up.

18 tools answer the weekly questions: replace, sell or keep; the best month to sell; the loan view; a refinance; an early payoff; profit by class; a safe owner draw; the tax set-aside; the scenario test; a sensitivity row; the business case for a new vehicle; a one-car host start-up case; the depreciation check; fleet cost per day; break-even revenue; the financing mix; sale proceeds against payoff; and the year-end pack check. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to the owner, manager, bookkeeper, accountant, lender and others.

A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data. Depreciation, replacement age, tax set-aside and every target are example settings, set your own. Amounts are plain numbers in one currency of your choice. It helps you keep track of your numbers and promises no result; check your local rules and confirm tax questions with your adviser.
